title: Computed value at a gate vertex
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, and let $x$ be an assignment to its inputs. For every gate index $i<|C.	ext{gates}|$, the computed value at vertex $n+i$ equals the evaluation of gate $i$ on the list of values computed by the circuit.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is an assignment to the $n$ inputs
